notes: world-daynight-s1 covers the day-night cycle the detector's tile entity reads; test_tileticks.c exercises the 20-tick schedule. The metadata write survives (flags 3), so the value is observable even without a consumer. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): reachable only through a world.conf switch that is off (redstone). Formerly listed as missing: BlockDaylightDetector.isProvidingWeakPower (the light level as redstone output) and the inverted-mode toggle are not ported: world.conf redstone = off.
